info.name: Smart Teacher Assistant - Complete API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for all Smart Teacher Assistant APIs.
Base URL variable: base_url = http://127.0.0.1:8000
Auth: set access_token after login.

v2.0 — includes: Admin Login, Subscription Plans, Teacher Subscriptions, Behavior Assessment, Student Cards PDF, Comprehensive Student Report PDF, Weekly Schedule.
